why: The strongest abliterated models a 24 GB Apple-silicon Mac can run, chosen 2026-10-15. Base models by current local benchmarks (Qwen3.8-27B and Qwen3.6-27B lead single-machine open models; Gemma 4 for images). Heretic builds preferred: published tests show the least capability loss (Qwen3.5-4B MMLU 74.38 base vs 74.28 Heretic vs 68.48 Huihui). Each file is capped at 16 GB, about what macOS lets the GPU use on a 24 GB Mac. Every download is checked against Hugging Bay's recorded SHA-256.
